Portfolio Manager Caroline Ader Thompson Caroline Ader Thompson joined Findlay Park in 2016 and is a portfolio manager of the Findlay Park American Fund. Prior to joining Findlay Park, Caroline was an equity research analyst at Fidelity International for four years, with responsibility for European consumer companies. Caroline began her investment career in 2009 at Ruffer. Back to Investment Team Portfolio Manager Jonathan Tredgett Portfolio Manager Charlie Southern
